note: Set A is better because it correctly identifies the 4x4 post and avoids the significant engineering error in Set B where the post cap width (3 3/4") is misidentified as the deck footing width (which is 1'-0"). Set A also has fewer redundant claims (e.g., Set B lists the bolt dimensions 5 times). However, both sets incorrectly bind the 8'-0" dimension to the C1 plan instead of the C3 elevation, and Set A includes some vague 'component' claims and merges the nut and sleeve entities.
